svg.title: HOLA: from CTA to segmentation and quality feedback
svg.desc: A CTA volume enters a 3D DynUNet with click prompts. The predicted mask and cropped CT enter a quality prediction network. A score below the selected threshold leads to further positive or negative clicks; a score meeting the threshold leads to review of the refined mask.

g.text: Framework illustrated with original CT and segmentation images from the viva presentation
The deck presents the complete interaction loop. This checkout contains training and evaluation scripts.
